Ибритумомаб Тиуксетан CAS — 206181-63-7. Adverse Effects and Precautions For general discussions, see Antineoplastics, p.635 and p.641. Myelosuppression is common after doses of ibritu- momab tiuxetan, and may be prolonged. Fatal intracra- nial haemorrhage has occurred. Infections and hyper- sensitivity reactions may also be severe.
